G0_ILLUSTRATIVE.description: Illustrative 35-obstacle, 1-target scene for scene-record and visual foundations. No target action exists; robot pose is the provisional, untested home.

G1_D0.description: D0: no obstacles. Corner cycle (0,0)->(0,7)->(7,7)->(7,0)->(0,0) and the 64-cell audit (pick each cell, place at its point-mirrored cell 63 - c).

G1_S1.description: Designated sparse development scene: 6 interior obstacles, all farther than L1 + housing_r + r + delta = 0.461 m from the base (outside the link-0/elbow sweep zone) and off the border columns. Corner cycle plus the G1 nominal reference action 36 -> 19: t0 is picked from between o02 (3,4) and o04 (5,4) and placed beside o00 (1,3).

G1_S2.description: Harder sparse stress scene (first S1 design): obstacles beside the border columns leave 0.032 m corridors for the carried disc. Kept to report planner limits honestly.

G1_CLUTTER.description: Full-clutter attempt in the G0 illustrative scene: move target t0 (cell 55) to free cell 36.

G2_D1.description: D1: sparse development scene (4 background obstacles present while gamma_0 is planned). t0 moves cell 18 -> 45. One existing obstacle is relocated into the frozen sweep, then relocated to an alternative admissible cell (privileged diagnostic edits).

G2_D2.description: D2: sparse development scene (6 background obstacles present while gamma_0 is planned). t0 moves cell 26 -> 53. Two existing obstacles are relocated, one edit each, into the frozen sweep (independent direct blockers), then corrected one at a time.

G3_D1.description: Archived G2 D1 blocked state (o02 intruded 50 -> 51), read-only. A0 + executable move-once search; the G2 diagnostic correction endpoint is tried as a real robot relocation.

G3_D2.description: Archived G2 D2 blocked state (o05 -> 50, o02 -> 57), read-only. Paired with the restricted-domain proxy G3_T07_PROXY.

compare.label: low-ID endpoints (A0 ties broken by cell ID, no carry-distance tie-break)

G3_D3.description: New development root: gamma_0 (t0 20 -> 44) planned with 5 background obstacles, then two privileged blocking edits put o00 (cell 28) and o01 (cell 27) side by side in the sweep. Selected by an explicit criterion: o00 has no admissible grasp while o01 is present (all rejections definite), o01 is graspable, and o00 becomes graspable once o01 is gone.

G3_T07_PROXY.description: DEVELOPMENT PROXY of T07/F8 (not dense): the D2 blocked state under a published restricted domain (the two direct blockers may use only the single nearest vacant action-clear cell other than their reference cells; all others stay), paired with its ALL_SUPPORTED twin.

G3_T07_DENSE.description: Dense T07/F8 terminal control: 35 obstacles on every cell outside the 0.461 m link-0 sweep zone except the nearest one; gamma_0 (t0 0 -> 34) planned and certified with this final dense background present; five existing IDs relocated into the frozen sweep (G2 rule). Restricted: blockers may use only the 4 nearest vacant action-clear non-reference cells (Hall); paired ALL_SUPPORTED twin.

G35_R0_D1REF.description: Archived G2 D1 reference scene (read-only). New query: transport t0 to goal cell 45. R0: all-stay should succeed; the one-move candidate tests unnecessary moves.

G35_R1_D1BLOCK.description: Archived G2 D1 blocked scene: the frozen G2/G3 gamma_0 collides with o02 (privileged diagnostic). R1: does a newly planned zero-move target action succeed from the same initial state? R6: the same all-stay query under a forced tiny planner budget.

scene.lineage: D1 reference layout with o03 placed on the goal cell 45 (constructed directly; no relocation)

G35_R2_GOAL.description: Goal cell 45 occupied by o03. R2: goal-overlap certificate (LB 1) plus a one-move witness. R3: two destinations. R5: static-valid o01 move leaves the goal occupied. R6: duplicate, target-at-rest, unsupported and gray-band endpoints.

scene.lineage: G3 D3 blocked layout (o00 5->28, o01 9->27 from the D3 reference), constructed directly

G35_R4_ACCESS.description: Goal cell 28 occupied by o00, whose grasp access is blocked by o01. R4: the same two-move assignment with o00 first (rejected) and o01 first (verified), then the newly planned target action.

G35_R5_D2BLOCK.description: Archived G2 D2 blocked scene. R5: all-stay is static-valid; the target evaluation result is recorded as found (a probe returned UNRESOLVED planner budget).
